Founder Flat Rate

$245 per accepted truck / week

Minimum two accepted trucks. Founder eligibility must be recorded; qualifying applications use the owner-approved open-list rules.

Standard Flat Rate

$299 per accepted truck / week

Minimum three accepted trucks for a new post-closure enrollment without a preserved Founder seat.

Flat Rate minimums count all accepted trucks in a mixed Dry Van and Reefer fleet. Reefer means dispatch coordination only; it does not include temperature monitoring or a temperature guarantee. Every plan remains subject to its signed carrier-specific terms.

Load linehaul and deadhead calculator

Compare linehaul per loaded mile with linehaul per total mile, including the empty approach.

Enter the linehaul amount, loaded miles, and deadhead miles.

Loaded-mile linehaul

—Linehaul divided by loaded miles.

All-mile linehaul

—Linehaul divided by loaded plus deadhead miles.

Total trip miles

—Loaded miles plus deadhead miles.

Deadhead share

—Deadhead miles as a share of total miles.

Difference between loaded-mile and all-mile rate: —. These are linehaul calculations, not profit estimates or operating-cost benchmarks.

Results exclude fuel, maintenance, insurance, driver pay, tolls, factoring, taxes, and dispatch fees. Use them as arithmetic for comparing a load, not as a profitability recommendation.

Weekly billing

  • The service week runs Monday through Sunday, Central Time.
  • Invoices issue Friday at noon; payment is available from issuance and due Friday evening.
  • Service continues through Monday morning. If payment is not received by then, service is suspended.
  • A Flat Rate week that has started is charged in full. Future weeks may be paused with notice; if the fleet falls below its minimum, written cure and transition rules apply.
